speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. This constellation of symptoms is concerning for a post-streptococcal complication or an ascending infection. To clarify your timeline and symptoms, did your fever persist or worsen after completing the antibiotics for your sinusitis?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis

Since your fever and symptoms persisted after treating your sinusitis, this suggests the infection has likely spread from the upper respiratory tract to your kidneys. I need to confirm if you are experiencing any urinary symptoms like burning, urgency, or frequency to support this suspicion. Additionally, please request a Urinalysis and Urine Culture to visualize white blood cells and identify the causative bacteria.
